description_expanded: Tucked into the heart of Grayton Beach , this newly constructed 6-bedroom, 7 full bath, and 1 half bath retreat blends elevated coastal design, Gulf views, expansive gathering spaces, and the laid-back charm that makes 30A unforgettable. Sleeping up to 20 guests, the home immediately stands out with its striking sky-blue exterior, multiple covered balconies, and private pool framed by mature trees and soft Gulf breezes. Just moments from the sugar-white shoreline, guests can enjoy glimpses of the sparkling Gulf from several outdoor spaces while still appreciating the privacy and quiet atmosphere of this sought-after neighborhood. Every detail of the home feels fresh, intentional, and beautifully curated for large family vacations, multi-family gatherings, or memorable group getaways. Inside Life’s Grayt , bright natural light pours through oversized windows into open-concept living spaces designed for connection and comfort. The main living area features layered coastal textures, oversized seating, warm wood accents, and designer lighting that gives the space an upscale yet welcoming feel. The chef’s kitchen serves as a stunning centerpiece with an oversized island, premium appliances, custom cabinetry, double pendant lighting, and generous seating that naturally draws everyone together for meals, conversation, and late-night snacks after the beach. Nearby dining areas provide plenty of room for gathering, while the seamless flow into the outdoor living spaces creates an effortless indoor-outdoor atmosphere throughout the home. The sleeping accommodations are equally impressive, with beautifully styled guest suites designed to feel calm, airy, and private after long days in the sun. Several bedrooms open onto spacious covered balconies lined with rocking chairs and lounge seating, offering peaceful spots to enjoy morning coffee, Gulf breezes, or quiet evenings beneath the trees. Each floor also features its own inviting indoor sitting area, giving guests additional space to spread out, unwind, and enjoy a quieter moment away from the main gathering spaces. Throughout the home, spa-inspired bathrooms showcase custom tilework, elegant vanities, soaking tubs, and refined coastal finishes that elevate the experience well beyond a typical beach house. Younger guests will especially love the custom-built bunk room, thoughtfully designed with both comfort and style in mind. Adding even more flexibility for entertaining and relaxing, the home also features a spacious indoor-outdoor lounge space overlooking the private pool. Designed for effortless coastal living, this covered retreat includes comfortable seating, a large television, an outdoor kitchen with a built-in grill, beverage refrigerator, and generous dining space perfect for casual lunches, evening cocktails, or family dinners after the beach. Oversized openings create a seamless connection to the backyard oasis, allowing guests to move easily between the pool deck and shaded lounge areas throughout the day. The private pool and surrounding lounge deck create a resort-style setting all your own, framed by lush greenery and the peaceful atmosphere of Grayton Beach. Covered porches, multiple balcony spaces, and shaded outdoor gathering areas make it easy to spend entire afternoons enjoying the coastal air, whether relaxing poolside, sharing meals outdoors, or unwinding beneath the soft glow of evening lights after a day along the Gulf. Located in sought-after Grayton Beach, guests are just a short walk or bike ride from public beach access, beloved local restaurants, boutique shopping, and the laid-back atmosphere that defines this iconic 30A community. Spend afternoons exploring nearby favorites like The Red Bar , Chiringo , Tribe Kelley Surf Post , and Zoo Gallery , all offering the distinct character and coastal charm that make Grayton Beach such a memorable destination. Nearby Western Lake and surrounding nature trails also provide opportunities for paddleboarding, kayaking, biking, and experiencing the natural beauty of the area beyond the beach. While Grayton Beach offers a charmingly laid-back escape all its own, you are also just minutes away from exploring the iconic neighboring communities of Seaside , WaterColor , and Rosemary Beach , putting the very best of the 30A lifestyle right at your fingertips. With brand-new construction, professionally designed interiors, multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, and an unbeatable Grayton Beach location, this home delivers the kind of elevated 30A getaway guests will remember long after vacation ends.
